The '''Void of Aogros''' was an expansive region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]]. The region did not contain any [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] with the exception of [[The Quintarad/Legends|the Quintarad]], a system of five [[Star/Legends|stars]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] each other. The Quintarad was believed to have been constructed by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> who had disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Void of Aogros was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the region was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding the Void of Aogros was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Void of Aogros in grid square H-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
